plugin.name: LibraryMapper
plugin.creator: Chris / NSP-0123456
plugin.desc: Map your large music library inside Lyrion: browse a virtual Genre\Artist\Year-Album layout with temporal (albums added recently) and quality (hi-res/CD/lossy) filters, simplify hundreds of raw genre tags into a few broad groups, and consolidate album artists - all without touching a single file on disk. Albums are filed under a single canonical artist name (spellings are merged, "Last, First" and lower case are normalized), while a collaboration such as "A & B" is filed under each of its artists. The artists are then filed alphabetically under their last name when they are a person ("Claude Nougaro" under N) and under the name they carry when they are a group ("Metallica" under M, "Miles Davis Quintet" under M, the ensemble word being skipped); the names written in Cyrillic, Hebrew, Japanese or Chinese are transliterated so that they are not left after the "z". A regular expression narrows the artist list down. A list of trusted names can be uploaded on the parameter page: those are always one single album artist and are never split. Includes an initialization phase, mapping validation and download/upload of mapping files from the plugin parameter page. The plugin is an application: it is listed in the "Apps" section of the web interface and of the Material skin, and the virtual tree opens from there.
plugin.changes: 0.6.2 - the names with accents are shown correctly again: the names of the artists, of the albums and of the mapping were encoded twice and came out broken (in the tree of the application and on the parameter page); the colours of the pages of the plugin are taken from the skin of the server and follow its theme, so that the band of the filters stays readable when a value is changed. 0.6.1 - the number of items of a level is chosen in the tree itself (10, 100, 1000 or unlimited) and holds for the whole drill-down. 0.6.0 - the plugin is an application now: it is listed in the "Apps" section of the web interface and of the Material skin and the virtual tree opens from there. The contents of the application open on a server where no player is connected. 0.5.0 - the initialization runs in the background with a progress bar on the parameter page, the tree is brought up to date by itself when a file is added to or removed from the library, the credits of a collaboration are split ("Andrea Keller & Sandy Evans" becomes two artists), the names with accents are shown correctly, the order of the artists can follow the date of the addition and the header of the tree shows the order and the filters that are in use. 0.4.1 - the order of the albums and of the genre groups can be chosen (three views in My Music: the default order, newest first and oldest first; plus a group order by name or by number of albums), a genre group that holds no album is never listed, the albums that carry no genre ("Pas de genre") are hidden by default and shown under the name "None", the cover art of the albums is the art of the album instead of the generic disc image, and a mapping that is uploaded on the parameter page is applied to the tree at once: the server does not have to be restarted and no new scan is needed. 0.4.0 - the browse node is registered with the server, so "Simplified View" appears in My Music (every skin, Material included). The artists are filed under their last name (a person) or under the name they carry (a group), the ensemble word is skipped, and the names that are not written in Latin letters are transliterated. A regular expression filter on the artist list, a list of trusted single-artist names that are uploaded on the parameter page, and the download/upload of the mapping file. 0.1.0 - first version.
